claim: Table C.1 row: the DFIR Report is the threat report the Gootloader flow cites, and supports its c4 class (neither stole data nor impeded systems).
quote: In this case, there was no further impact to the environment before the threat actors were evicted.
issue: Adversarial read: the actors 'used this access to review sensitive documents' (PDF p. 1) and opened document files over RDP (PDF p. 24), but the report names no exfiltration (no 'exfil' anywhere in the saved text), so 'did not steal data' holds as an absence; reviewing is not taking. The flow cites this DFIR Report URL. Holds.
